title: Pyramid of the Sun
source: Retained exact pyramid identity,one inspected frontal picture and standard PMTiles/Mapzen terrain.
axis: +X east-southeast across the pyramid;+Y up;+Z south-southwest. The principal stair faces native-X toward the Avenue of the Dead.
identityStatus: Q29238/relation3373254 identifies the pyramid. Standard pinned PMTiles principal building52776561506502 and24 roof/platform parts define the225m main base, west projection, terrace edges and signed15.53-degree axis. The full parent outline including projections is236×222m.

orientationControl.basis: Parallel mapped terrace edges establish the signed15.53-degree east/south axis. The independently mapped projecting fore-platform and frontal photograph resolve the west-facing approach.

reconstruction.scope: Specific Pyramid of the Sun exterior: five mapped sloping stages, horizontal terraces and flat summit; continuous west stair flights, landings and independently mapped projecting lower U-shaped platforms. No intact summit temple, individual stone inventory, visitors or hidden interiors.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Unmodified161-square/6m normal Mapzen-USGS grid retained. Coarse edge heights and the reconstructed65m summit are visualization fits,not surveyed elevations.
